preconditions.expression: len(s) >= 3 and all('A' <= c <= 'Z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input string s has length at least 3 and contains only uppercase letters A-Z.
Input string s contains at least three distinct characters.

postconditions.expression: all(ord(s[i]) >= ord(s[i+1]) for i in range(len(return_value)-1))
postconditions.description: The returned string has characters in non-increasing ASCII order.

postconditions.expression: all(ord(return_value[i+1]) - ord(return_value[i]) == ord(return_value[1]) - ord(return_value[0]) for i in range(len(return_value)-2))
postconditions.description: The returned string forms an arithmetic progression with common difference d = ord(return_value[1]) - ord(return_value[0]).

postconditions.expression: d := ord(return_value[1]) - ord(return_value[0]) if len(return_value) > 1 else 0; d >= 1
postconditions.description: The common difference d of the arithmetic progression is at least 1.

postconditions.expression: not any(len(candidate) > len(return_value) and all(ord(candidate[i]) >= ord(candidate[i+1]) for i in range(len(candidate)-1)) and all(ord(candidate[i+1]) - ord(candidate[i]) == ord(candidate[1]) - ord(candidate[0]) for i in range(len(candidate)-2)) and (ord(candidate[0]) > ord(return_value[0]) or (ord(candidate[0]) == ord(return_value[0]) and (ord(candidate[1]) - ord(candidate[0])) <= (ord(return_value[1]) - ord(return_value[0])))) for candidate in [substring for substring in [s[i:j] for i in range(len(s)) for j in range(i+3, len(s)+1)] if len(substring) >= 3])
postconditions.description: The returned string is the longest possible substring satisfying Q1, Q2, and Q3. Among such substrings, it has the highest starting ASCII value. If tied, it has the smallest common difference.
